outcomes.reads: I want to work on post-training where the engineering directly shapes model behavior. At Amazon and now at Aria I've built the pipeline side of ML systems (a low-latency inference service, an eval harness that graded 28 tasks at 86% exact-pass), and most recently I ran GRPO post-training on Qwen3-4B with verifiable rewards, lifting pass rate from 38.6% to 41.0% over 280 steps. Anthropic is the place doing that at frontier scale with safety as a first-class constraint, not an afterthought, and I want to bring that engineering rigor to it.
